module_reset_inference: Module manual marks LCD pin11 NC and onboard RC reset. IC manufacturer supports REG01h bit0 software reset1->0 once SPI works. Thus a proposed harness can reserve J10.7 instead of falsely promising LCD hardware reset. Cold boot, brownout and bus-hang recovery remain hardware/driver test gates.
